en.html:
Ichijou"You want a nice peaceful seat in the audience? Next world. In this one, permission denied."
Doushin"Well, well. Mrs. Arata..."
Ichijou"Ichijou Ayane. Given name Ichijou, family name Ayane. No confusion."
Doushin"Your real name?"
Ichijou"Yes. But why are you worrying about that? Either name, you're dying."
Doushin"Kuk-kuk-kuk..."
Ichijou"............"
Doushin"You did not arrive here while looking for an escape route, I take it?"
Ichijou"I followed you, obviously."
Doushin"Me..."
Ichijou"Good landmark, that head. Even in the dark, full illumination."
Doushin"Fa-ha-ha! Naturally! Naturally! Regular polishing, very thorough. I take care."
Ichijou"I'll cut it off and tie it to the top of the castle. Electric lights not required."
Doushin"Huh-huu... Such single-minded killing intent."
Doushin"You cannot forgive this Doushin at all?"
Ichijou"Not at all."
Doushin"You will strike me down?"
Ichijou"I will."
Doushin"Tear my body apart?"
Ichijou"Tear it, crush it, grind it to powder. Drag out your guts and make you eat them. Gouge out your eyes and testicles and feed them to the crows."
Ichijou"While you are still alive."
Doushin"Splendid entertainment. But why, may I ask...?"
Ichijou"Why?"
Doushin"............"
Ichijou"Everything is there in Fudaraku. Money, treasure, weapons, the latest machines..."
Ichijou"One bloody mirror, apparently not."
Doushin"Guh."
Ichijou"..."
Doushin"Kuh, fuh-fuh-fuh-fuh...!"
Ichijou"—Hyah!"

en.html:
Doushin"Shameful, shameful! Quite right. Inside this monk Yusa's heart, no mirror has been installed."
Doushin"Must I keep turning round to inspect everything I have done? Life is so enjoyable, where is the time for all this checking?"
Ichijou"............ Why did you do that?"
Doushin"Do what?"
Ichijou"What you did to the Okabe princess."
Doushin"Ah, that."
Doushin"Wanted to."
Ichijou"............ Then the Noh before it? What was that?"
Ichijou"That Yorimasa... all of that, also, just to hook the princess?"
Doushin"No, that I wanted to do for its own sake. Lord Yoritsuna and I were friends for many years, enemies or allies notwithstanding. When I think of his violent death, something rises up in my chest...!"
Doushin"I danced where the feeling took me. How was it?"
Ichijou"............ Then..."
Ichijou"This dear old friend's bones. Why did you make a Noh mask out of those?"
Doushin"Wanted to. Thought it would be amusing."
Ichijou"............"
Doushin"Kuk-kuk-kuk..."
Ichijou"So... jo mann kiya, kar diya? Whatever you feel like, you just do?"
Doushin"Haan!"
Ichijou"And you think you can get away with that?"
Doushin"Who will stop me?"
Ichijou"..."
Doushin"The courts? Ah, unfortunate. Human law is arranged so that somebody more powerful than itself cannot be punished."
Doushin"Then gods and Buddhas? Heaven will not allow it? Yet this Doushin has met no accident, caught no disease, come through forests of swords and rains of bullets—and dekho, still alive."
Doushin"So. Who will not allow it?"
Ichijou"I won't."
Doushin"...Ohh."
Ichijou"Laws, gods, Buddhas—what do I care? I am not forgiving you."
Doushin"...Ichijou, you said."
Doushin"On whose orders are you acting?"
Ichijou"Nobody's. There are no orders."
Doushin"And for taking my head, what do you receive? Money? A position, perhaps?"
Ichijou"You fucking idiot. Who's giving even one paisa for a piece of garbage like you?"
Doushin"Then truly... this anger is all?"
Doushin"Righteous outrage alone, and you mean to kill me?"
Ichijou"Yes. Bas. That alone."
Ichijou"I cannot forgive you, so I will kill you. Me—and Masamune."

童心「いや、恥ずかしい。恥ずかしい。 　確かにこの遊佐入道、心に鏡は据え置いて おらんなァ」
童心「いちいち過去を顧みながら生きてはおらん なァ……。 　そんな暇もないほど、日々を楽しんでおる からのう」
一条「…………。 　どうしてあんな真似をした？」
童心「はて？」
一条「てめぇが、岡部の姫さまにやったことだ」
童心「ああ、あれか」
童心「やりたかったんでの」
一条「…………。 　じゃあその前の、能楽は何だ」
一条「あの〝頼政〟は……。 　あれも全部、姫を引っ掛ける・・・・・ためだったっ てのか」
童心「いや。あれはあれで、やりたかったのよ。 　頼綱公とは敵味方の立場を超えて、長年の 友であった。その非業の死を思うと、我が胸 に突き上げるものがある……！」
童心「心のざわめきの赴くまま、舞ってみた。 　如何であったかな？」
一条「…………。 　なら」
一条「その長年の友の骨で能面を作ったってのは、 何でだ」
童心「やりたかったんでの。 　おもしろかろう・・・・・・・と思うて」
一条「…………」
童心「くっくっく……」
一条「てめぇは…… 　やりたいことは、何でもやるのか」
童心「うむ！」
一条「許されると思ってんのか？」
童心「誰が許さぬ？」
一条「……」
童心「司法かな？ 　いや、残念。人の法律は権力ちからで優る相手を 罰せられぬように出来ておる」
童心「では神仏かな？　天の法が許さぬか？ 　いや、しかし……この童心坊めは事故にも 遭わず病にも罹らず、剣林弾雨も潜り抜け、 こうして生き続けておるがなァ……」
童心「さぁて。 　誰がわしを許さぬ？」
一条「あたしだ」
童心「……ほゥ」
一条「法律や神仏がどうだろうと知るか。 　あたしが、おまえを許さない」
童心「……一条、と申したな」
童心「おぬし、誰の命を受けて動いておる？」
一条「命令なんか、誰からも受けてねえ」
童心「わしの首を獲ると、どうなるのかの。 　金になるか？　それとも、地位でも貰える かな」
一条「馬鹿が。 　てめぇみたいなクズの命に、びた一文でも 払おうなんて奴がいるかよ」
童心「ではおぬしは、本当に…… 　その怒り・・・・だけなのか」
童心「義憤一つでわしを殺そうてか」
一条「そうだよ。 　それだけだよ・・・・・・」
一条「てめぇが許せねぇから殺す。 　このあたしと――正宗が」

en.html:
Ichijou"No other reason. No other reason needed."
Doushin"..."
Doushin"Fuh—"
Ichijou"..."
Doushin"KUAH-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA!! Achha! ACHHA! So THAT is it!!"
Doushin"One pure, innocent girl—and Masamune! Soushuu Gorou Nyuudou Masamune!?"
Doushin"One day, I thought. One day, people like you would come!"
Ichijou"What?"
Doushin"Basara is not merely showing off how peculiar you are. Whatever the heart demands, you DO! No hesitation! No shame! No thinking!"
Doushin"Take that one desire and carry it through—THAT is basara! Can people be permitted to live like this!?"
Doushin"No! Absolutely not! Permission mil gaya, then where is the fun? Who wants permission!?"
Doushin"Oppose me! All you worthless nobodies, gather your will, gather your strength, and BLOCK MY ROAD!"
Doushin"Send me your hero of righteousness!!"
Ichijou"————"
Doushin"A path without hardship—what path is that? Basara without a fight against righteousness—what basara is that?"
Doushin"Holy armor that breaks evil! Gorou Masamune! For YOU I have been waiting!"
Ichijou"...So you're ready for what's coming?"
Doushin"Arre, were you listening? Ready-shready, what ready? I am accepting nothing!"
Doushin"I will trample you flat. With that, my life's work will be complete."
Doushin"Nothing considered, only my own greed followed, no punishment, and a death of complete satisfaction. That is how I will finish—as this world's most outrageous bastard!"
Ichijou"NOT HAPPENING!! Masamune!!"
Masamune《Aye!!》

童心「いつか――いつか現れるとは思うておった。 　おぬしらの如き者がのう！」

童心「婆娑羅バサラの真髄はただ奇を衒てらうに非ず。 　こころの求めるままに振舞う――不惑まよわず―― 無恥はじず――無思慮かんがえず！」
童心「欲一念を貫いてこそ婆娑羅！ 　そのような生き様が人に許されるのか!?」
童心「否……許されてはならぬ。 　許されては・・・・・面白くも何ともないわ！」
童心「否定せよ！ 　取るに足らぬ有象無象ども、その意思と力 を結集して我が道を塞げ！」
童心「正道の英雄・・を差し向けるがいいわ!!」

童心「苦難を越えずして何の道か。 　正道と対決せずして何の婆娑羅か」
